notes: Every simulated test uses fixtures/fake-runner.mjs: no real model call, no real DSH headless run and no Codex integration took place.
The real MCP protocol round trip and the raw-stdio framing check speak the real MCP protocol over real stdio child processes; only the DSH child is simulated.
The A01 checks read installed DSH package metadata and parse the desktop app.asar read-only.
2026-10-12 publication verification; existing locked dependencies reused, no model tasks.
Public snapshot: checkout path removed; configuration/templates and documentation updated, runtime source unchanged.
